title: When Agent Skills Go Stale: Runtime Behavior and Selective Maintenance in Evolving Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.22525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills use past experience and current observations to guide decisions and actions on related tasks. This experience is retained in skill state, whose reuse can amortize inference-time reasoning and environment interaction. When environment changes, parts of this state can become outdated while others remain useful. Across four task settings and two models, we compare skill reuse before and after environment changes. Previously beneficial skills can reduce task performance by over 10 percentage points or increase execution cost by nearly 40% relative to no skill. Task success can also remain unchanged while execution savings decline. These effects depend on which environment-specific details become outdated and the agent's ability to compensate using current observations. translated_title: 当智能体技能过时：演化环境中的运行时行为与选择性维护
translated_abstract: 智能体技能利用过去的经验和当前的观察来指导相关任务上的决策与行动。这些经验被保留在技能状态中，其复用可以摊销推理时的推理开销与环境交互成本。当环境发生变化时，该状态中的部分内容可能变得过时，而其他部分仍然有用。我们在四个任务设置和两个模型上，比较了环境变化前后的技能复用效果。与不使用技能相比，先前有益的技能可能使任务性能降低超过10个百分点，或使执行成本增加近40%。任务成功率也可能保持不变，而执行节省却下降。这些效应取决于哪些环境特定的细节变得过时，以及智能体利用当前观察进行补偿的能力。我们提出了选择性维护方法，它在无需额外模型调用的情况下，重放成功执行中的检查，以验证观察到的差异是否混淆了技能的价值……
tldr: 该论文发现环境变化会导致智能体复用的技能状态过时，使性能下降超过10个百分点或执行成本增加近40%，并提出了一种无需额外模型调用的“选择性维护”方法来验证技能是否仍然有效。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that environment changes can make reused agent skill states stale—cutting task performance by over 10 percentage points or raising execution cost by nearly 40%—and introduces selective maintenance, which replays checks from successful executions without additional model calls to verify whether skills remain useful.
